identified_limitations: Cargo.lock is regenerated deterministically by the CI runner because the local machine intentionally has no Rust toolchain; the committed lock file is refreshed by the workflow's generate-lockfile step.
The native folder picker returns null in browser mock mode by design; real OS dialogs only exist in the packaged Tauri shell.

npm run test:ui-layout resolves Microsoft Edge from fixed Program Files paths and is therefore a local-machine verification; the CI quality job runs the equivalent Node/Python suites on ubuntu-latest.
gh CLI must be invoked via its full path because C:\Windows\System32\gh.exe shadows the real binary on PATH; an environment quirk, not a project defect.
The close button hides the window to the system tray per PROMPT 0; a true exit remains available only from the tray menu.
